description: Tunable rules for local CPU/ffmpeg preprocessing of 1-Battle DVR recordings and deep traces. Edit any threshold or window here to adjust what screenshots and contact sheets are saved locally.

battleStart.description: Start of battle: countdown, opening lead nameplate lock-in, and initial HP/energy bar appearance.

chargedMoveTransitions.description: All transitions IN to charged moves (camera zoom, circle shrink, shield prompt, banner) and OUT of charged moves (camera unzoom, post-cutscene HP settling, energy deduction, and buff/debuff callout validation).

buffsAndDebuffs.description: All Attack/Defense buff or debuff callouts, Mimikyu Disguise bust events, Mimikyu swap-in GUI reminders, and stat stage changes.

largeHpChangesAndAnimations.description: All large HP changes (drops, KOs, or upward resets) including the full pre-drop animation, drain interpolation, and post-drop settling period.

speciesSwapsAndFaints.description: All player or opponent switch-ins, faints, and Pokéball count changes.

energyAnomaliesAndJumps.description: Sudden charge circle fill drops without a move throw, or large single-step energy jumps.

battleEnd.description: End of battle: final KO, YOU WIN! / GOOD EFFORT! banner, and auto-end detection window.
